summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Budget features for CAP Encampment Financial Tracker. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified Budget page loads with summary dashboard, Food Expense Settings dialog allows editing cost per person per day, Budget items CRUD works, and access is restricted to Commander/Finance roles.

passed_tests: Backend - Commander can login
Backend - GET /api/budget returns array of budget items
Backend - POST /api/budget creates new budget item with all fields (category, item_name, estimated, actual, vendor, item_type, payment_status)
Backend - POST /api/budget can create income items (item_type: income)
Backend - PUT /api/budget/{id} updates existing budget item
Backend - DELETE /api/budget/{id} removes budget item
Backend - GET /api/budget/summary returns total_estimated, total_actual, variance, by_category
Backend - GET /api/budget/food-settings returns cost_per_person_per_day, total_participants, total_days, total_food_budget
Backend - Food settings calculation: total_food_budget = cost × participants × days
Backend - PUT /api/budget/food-settings updates settings and recalculates total
Backend - PUT /api/budget/food-settings allows partial updates
Backend - Finance role can access /api/budget
Backend - Finance role can access /api/budget/food-settings
Backend - Cadet role gets 403 on /api/budget
Backend - Cadet role gets 403 on /api/budget/food-settings
Backend - Cadet role cannot create budget items (403)
Backend - POST /api/budget/{id}/receipt uploads image successfully
Backend - DELETE /api/budget/{id}/receipt removes receipt
Backend - POST /api/budget/{id}/receipt rejects invalid file types (400)
Backend - Commander can update user role to 'finance'
Frontend - Financial Tracker header displays

Frontend - Food Expense Settings dialog opens via Food Planner button
Frontend - Food Settings dialog has Cost Per Person Per Day input (editable)
Frontend - Food Settings dialog has Total Participants input
Frontend - Food Settings dialog has Total Days input
Frontend - Add Budget Item dialog has Type dropdown (expense/income)
Frontend - Add Budget Item dialog has Category dropdown
Frontend - Add Budget Item dialog has Item Name, Vendor, Estimated, Actual inputs
Frontend - Budget table has columns: Category, Item, Vendor, Estimated, Actual, Receipt, Status, Actions
Frontend - Admin page shows Finance role with permissions: Full budget access, Manage expenses & income, Upload receipts, Food expense planning
